title: Split reviews record only the first part’s spend
description: Each part receives usage, but `fold_review_parts()` copies only the first part’s metadata. Subsequent parts’ tokens, turns, duration, and cost disappear before persistence. Reproduced with two parts costing $1 and $2: the folded record reports $1. Aggregate all parts’ usage and add a split-review accounting test.

title: Run totals omit earlier loop iterations
description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. The executor keeps earlier iterations in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, but `StateManager._append_step()` serializes only the final iteration’s `action_results`; the round observer records nothing. Consequently, retry/revision loops report only their last round’s spend. Preserve earlier rounds durably and test totals across multiple iterations.

title: Fan-out usage is discarded during reduction
description: Capture reaches each branch, but the persisted result contains only the reducer output. `CollectReducer` drops branch metadata, `FirstPassReducer` also omits usage, and failed branches produce an empty action list. Reproduced a successful collect reduction returning empty metadata despite priced branch records. Preserve every branch’s spend independently of which output wins reduction.

title: Standalone subscription reviews lose their cost classification
description: `requestedModel` is not an alias field: persistence emits it only on model substitution, and its value is the resolved model ID. Normal reviews therefore load with `alias=None`, preventing `cost_cell()` from identifying subscription costs as API-rate equivalents. Reproduced a subscription review displaying `$1.00 prov`. Persist and read the actual selected alias rather than repurposing `requestedModel`.

title: Malformed cost basis crashes the entire reviews report
description: The set-membership check assumes `costBasis` is hashable. Valid YAML such as `costBasis: [provider]` raises `TypeError`, aborting the report instead of warning and retaining the row with an unknown basis. Validate that the value is a string before membership testing, and cover list and mapping values in tests.

title: Loop totals omit earlier iterations
description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. Loop execution stores earlier iterations in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, which `StateManager._append_step()` does not persist. A two-round reproduction costing $1 and $2 reported only $2. Persist and include every round’s usage, with regression coverage.

title: Split reviews count only the first part
description: Each part receives usage, but `fold_review_parts()` copies only the first part’s metadata without summing usage. Two parts costing $1 and $2 produced a $1 record. Their artifacts are also excluded from standalone statistics by `runId`, so the omitted spend appears nowhere. Aggregate all parts before persistence.

title: Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
description: The newly returned failure result has empty outputs and, for ordinary reviews, no verdict. Multi-part folding requires an input file, response, and verdict for every part. Reproduction raised `TypeError: review part must name exactly one input file, got []`, replacing the provider failure and discarding captured usage. Handle failed parts explicitly and test a mixed successful/failed review.

title: Fan-out reduction discards captured branch usage
description: Passing capture into branches is insufficient: only the reducer’s result is persisted. `CollectReducer` strips branch metadata, while `FirstPassReducer` also returns no usage metadata. Consequently, statistics omit branch spend without even counting those calls as unrecorded LLM actions. Preserve branch usage independently of the selected reduction.

title: Failed compaction drops available telemetry
description: Usage is stamped only after successful compaction. A `ProviderError` carrying completed-turn telemetry returns empty metadata instead; a reproduction confirmed this. Capture error telemetry before returning failure, and preserve summary spend if subsequent reconnection fails.

title: Malformed cost basis crashes the entire review report
description: A YAML list or mapping in `costBasis` reaches set membership and raises `TypeError` because it is unhashable. This bypasses the documented warning-and-`None` behavior. Validate that the value is a string before membership testing; cover list and mapping inputs.
